answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7934 Country: India Title: My Malasian friend put names his sons as Abuhuraira and Abusahidulqudri, please confirm is it good? Question: My Malasian friend put names his sons as Abuhuraira and Abusahidulqudri, please confirm is it good? Answer ID: 7934 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1210/1056=L/1429) Yes, it is right, but it would have been better if he had kept the names as Abu Bakr or Abu Ayyub instead, thus the names of both sons would have been matching those of the Sahaba (companions). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
